questions.q: In which city was Archduke Franz Ferdinand shot in 1914?
questions.why: It led to the First World War.

questions.q: In which year did Bosnia and Herzegovina declare independence?
questions.why: A war followed until 1995.

questions.q: Which 1995 agreement ended the Bosnian War?
questions.why: It was negotiated in Ohio, USA.

questions.q: Which 1995 massacre is recognised as genocide?
questions.why: Over 8,000 Bosniak men and boys were killed.

questions.q: Which empire ruled Bosnia for about 400 years?
questions.why: It ended in 1878.

questions.q: Which empire took over Bosnia in 1878?
questions.why: It annexed Bosnia in 1908.

questions.q: How long did the siege of Sarajevo last?
questions.why: It was the longest siege of a capital in modern history.

questions.q: Which medieval king was the most powerful ruler of Bosnia?
questions.why: He was crowned king in 1377.

questions.q: Which medieval Bosnian ban is linked to a famous trade charter of 1189?
questions.why: The charter was with Dubrovnik.

questions.q: What are medieval Bosnian tombstones called?
questions.why: They are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which old bridge in Mostar was rebuilt after the war?
questions.why: Divers jump from it into the Neretva.

questions.q: Which Sarajevo neighbourhood had a famous tunnel during the siege?
questions.why: The tunnel ran under the airport.

questions.q: What is the capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina?
questions.why: It hosted the 1984 Winter Olympics.

questions.q: Which river flows through Mostar?
questions.why: It flows to the Adriatic.

questions.q: Which waterfall flows into the centre of Jajce?
questions.why: The town has a medieval fortress above it.

questions.q: Which national park is home to the Štrbački Buk waterfall?
questions.why: It is on the Croatian border.

questions.q: Which national park has one of Europe's last primeval forests?
questions.why: The Perućica forest is there.

questions.q: Which Bosnian footballer captained Roma and played for Inter?
questions.why: He is Bosnia's all-time top scorer.

questions.q: Which mountains near Sarajevo hosted Olympic skiing in 1984?
questions.why: They are still ski resorts.

questions.q: Which film festival is held in Sarajevo each summer?
questions.why: It began during the siege in 1995.

questions.q: Which Bosnian director won the Oscar for 'No Man's Land'?
questions.why: It won Best Foreign Language Film in 2002.

questions.q: Which Bosnian-born writer won the 1961 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: He wrote 'The Bridge on the Drina'.

questions.q: Which writer from Tuzla wrote 'Death and the Dervish'?
questions.why: It was published in 1966.

questions.q: What are the two entities created by the Dayton Agreement?
questions.a: Federation of BiH and Republika Srpska
questions.why: Brčko District is a separate unit.

questions.q: Which bridge in Višegrad was built by Grand Vizier Mehmed Paša Sokolović?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: What is the currency of Bosnia and Herzegovina?
questions.why: It is pegged to the euro.

questions.q: Which grilled minced-meat dish is famous in Sarajevo?
questions.why: They are served in flatbread with onions.

questions.q: Which old bazaar is the heart of Sarajevo?
questions.why: It dates from the 1400s.

questions.q: Which flaky pastry filled with meat is a Bosnian favourite?
questions.why: Other fillings are called pita.

questions.q: Which Bosnian pyramid claim near Visoko is rejected by scientists?
questions.why: They are natural hills.
